name: Emosnull Content Studio for n8n
author: asandeepkumar

sections.description:
This plugin requires the companion n8n workflows. Configure your own n8n base URL, WordPress worker application password, shared webhook secret, AI model/rates and trusted source hosts. It has no service operated by the author and embeds no personal credentials.

The plugin creates private drafts, not published articles. It stores automated review flags for human editors. Search Console reporting is optional and requires your own verified property and Google OAuth credential in n8n.

External services

Your configured n8n instance receives job tickets and approved job context. For drafting, your n8n workflow sends brief text and source excerpts to OpenAI’s Responses API (https://api.openai.com/v1/responses), then sends a second request for automated review. OpenAI terms and privacy: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ and https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ . Review your applicable API business terms and account data controls.

Optional Search Console reporting sends queries to Google’s Search Console API using your n8n credential. Google API terms: https://developers.google.com/terms ; privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy . No connection is made until the administrator configures and starts a workflow.

Optional AI Search Visibility sends administrator-entered public questions directly to OpenAI with web search, approximate country and requested language. Explicit paid-run confirmation is required. It stores answer and citation evidence with configurable retention. This is sampled API citation measurement, not consumer AI rankings. Customers supply their own API keys and pay their provider directly.

Approved source URLs are retrieved by your WordPress server. Page audits fetch published pages from your own site. No telemetry is sent to the package author.

Limitations

Single-site release. PHP DOM, mbstring and OpenSSL are required. Supports MySQL/MariaDB with mysqli and named locks, or the WordPress SQLite Database Integration (including Playground). SQLite uses non-expiring owner-token mutexes; see docs/DATABASE-LOCKS.md for interrupted-run recovery. One language per brief; no bulk translation. HTML/plain-text sources only. Budgets are usage-based estimates, not invoices. Human editorial review remains necessary. Other SEO plugins may require compatibility work.

Tutorial

The complete written tutorial is bundled in docs/SETUP.md. Importable companion workflows are in workflows/. The recording guide is docs/DEMO.md.

Start on staging. Configure the worker account, authenticated n8n webhooks, trusted sources and budgets. Save and approve one brief, then inspect the resulting private draft and review flags. Publishing remains a separate human action.

Updates

This Community build contains no external updater. Once accepted into the directory, updates are delivered by WordPress.org using the normal WordPress update controls.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin ZIP on staging.
  2. Read the bundled docs/SETUP.md and import the n8n workflow JSON files.
  3. Create a Content Studio Worker user and application password.
  4. Bind credentials and the site URL in n8n, then configure Content Studio > Setup.
  5. Save a brief, review it and explicitly approve generation.
sections.faq:
Is this free?

The Community plugin is free. No donation or license key is required. You pay your own hosting and API providers. A ChatGPT subscription does not include OpenAI API usage.

Is n8n required?

n8n is required for article drafting and the companion reporting workflows. Internal-link checks and AI citation sampling run in WordPress. AI sampling requires your own OpenAI API connection.

Does it publish automatically or guarantee rankings?

No. It creates drafts for review and records audit recommendations. API citation samples do not measure consumer ChatGPT or Google AI Overview rankings.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Added SQLite/Playground locking with owner-only release and fail-closed interruption handling.
  • Serialized budget reservations across jobs and checked budget transaction failures.

1.0.1

  • Load dashboard assets through WordPress enqueue APIs.
  • Validate request types and allowlist form fields before processing.

1.0.0

Community distribution using WordPress.org updates, customer API-key setup, encrypted key storage, data export/deletion, retention controls, activation checks and upgrade data preservation.

0.3.0

Added internal-link suggestions, same-host broken-link checks, version-bound review decisions and bounded browser-driven scanning. Approval never edits published posts.

0.1.0

Initial portable pilot with draft approval, trusted sources, two AI stages, budget reservations, private-draft creation and optional reporting workflows.
